The OR gate is represented by the rounded triangle symbol..
DISCUSSION
Each OR gate has two or more inputs and a single output.
The function of an OR gate is to determine when at least one input condition is true. A HIGH output is available when any input is HIGH.
This circuit demonstrates the function of an OR gate.......
If S1 OR S2 is ON (closed) then the light is on.
When ANY input to the OR gate is HIGH, the gate produces a HIGH output.
If both inputs are LOW the gate produces a LOW output......

An OR gate only produces a LOW output when all inputs are LOW.

Generally, inputs to an OR gate are voltages or pulsed waveforms that change between two logic levels.
LOGIC LEVELS - Logic levels represent HIGH or LOW conditions. The HIGH condition is always a higher voltage than the LOW condition.
If the waveforms on A or B are HIGH the output on X is HIGH.

Compare the X output waveform at T1 to the A and B waveform at T1.

Note, when A is LOW and B is HIGH, X is HIGH.

At T4, input A is HIGH and input B is LOW. If any input to an OR gate is HIGH, the output is HIGH.

The output is LOW at T3 and T4. The input on B must be LOW at the same time intervals.
TRY AGAIN!
